# MALARIA TREATMENT

Consider malaria in any febrile person who has traveled to a malaria-endemic area in preceding months Search "CDC malaria countries" for malaria endemic areas
Link to open internet browser and Google search "CDC Malaria Countries"

Obtain malaria smear and call ID on-call in ALL cases when a malaria test is sent
Malaria Smear lab order

## Treatment

Coartem + prior auth bundle: artemether 80 mg/lumefantrine 480 mg twice daily for 3 days, the first 2 doses should be administered 8 hours apart Artesunate is appropriate in certain situations e.g. severe malaria - contact Infectious Diseases on call
